summary.headline: Orders and revenue beat weekly targets and hit an 8-week high, but the quarter stays behind at 92.6% and cancellations rose again.

points.what: Orders reached 829, up 4.0% week on week and up 60% on last year, outside the 8-week range around the 760 average.
points.so_what: This lifted orders to 101.5% of the 817 weekly target, though 60% growth is still below the 75% growth the targets assume.

points.what: Gross revenue was $60,698, up 10.9% week on week and 49.6% on last year, against a weekly target of $59,654.
points.so_what: Revenue finished at 101.8% of target and above the 8-week average of $55,323.

points.what: Quarter-to-date revenue is $654,201 against a target to date of $706,549, a gap of $52,348 with one week left in the quarter.
points.so_what: A strong week does not change the quarter, which remains behind at 92.6% attainment.

points.what: The cancellation rate rose to 16.4%, up 1.0 percentage point on the week and 1.3 points on last year.
points.so_what: At $726 of revenue per percentage point, the higher rate weighs on an otherwise strong revenue week.

points.what: The cancellation rate has risen three weeks in a row, from 14.3% to 16.4%.
points.so_what: Each percentage point of cancellations is worth $726 of weekly revenue, so a sustained streak is material.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 02 Mar 2026 was 9.2%, down 1.4 points on the week but 2.2 points above last year.
points.so_what: The two most recent weeks are not yet mature, so this is the latest week that can be read reliably.

points.what: New customer signups fell to 214, down 9.3% on the week and outside their 8-week range, while orders rose 4.0%.
points.so_what: Order growth this week did not come with matching growth in the new customer base.

points.what: Orders hit 101.5% of the 817 weekly target and revenue 101.8% of the $59,654 target, both ahead.
points.so_what: Next week's bar is higher, at 831 orders and $68,006 of revenue.

points.what: Quarter-to-date revenue of $654,201 is 92.6% of target, and $120,354 is still needed in the final week to reach the full-quarter target of $774,555.
points.so_what: That is roughly double this week's $60,698, so the quarter is set to close behind target.

points.what: Year-to-date revenue is also 92.6% of target, with $3,234,601 left over 41 weeks to reach the full-year target of $3,888,802.
points.so_what: The required weekly run-rate of $78,893 is well above the recent 8-week run-rate of $56,578.

points.what: APAC added 46 orders, up 13.5% to 387, accounting for 143.8% of the total weekly change.
points.so_what: APAC alone more than explains the week's order growth and holds a 46.7% share of orders.

points.what: LATAM fell 30.4% to 87 orders, a loss of 38 orders, or -118.8% of the total change.
points.so_what: Without the LATAM decline, the week's order gain would have been considerably larger.

points.what: Search contributed 34 of the net order gain, 106.2% of the change, while Organic gave back 11 orders and Display 7.
points.so_what: Growth rests on Search, which carries 71.9% of all orders.

points.what: Average order value was $87.59, up 7.8% on the week but down 5.0% against last year's $92.24.
points.so_what: Revenue growth of 49.6% year on year is therefore coming from order volume rather than basket size.

points.what: The cancellation rate reached 16.4%, up from 15.4% last week and 15.1% a year ago.
points.so_what: With $726 of revenue per percentage point, the year-on-year increase of 1.3 points is a meaningful drag.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 02 Mar 2026 was 9.2%, down 1.4 points on the prior week.
points.so_what: It remains 2.2 points above the 7.0% recorded a year earlier.

points.what: New customer signups were 214, down 9.3% on the week and 1.4% on last year, while orders grew 60% year on year.
points.so_what: Order growth is running well ahead of new customer growth.
